svg.title: Dynamic-14 task overview
svg.desc: Fourteen recorded native-expert task examples. One or two sparse translucent blue meshes show earlier poses. Navy paths follow recorded target centers; local gray arrows denote translation, rotation or oscillation qualitatively. The impact label marks the target center at a recorded contact time, not the contact point. No future prediction is shown. Text and all arrows are editable vectors; historical meshes are editable in companion Blender scenes.
